items.title: Ferring bets on Gameto’s reproductive health solution through $1.38bn takeover
items.summary: Gameto’s lead asset is a cell-based IVM tool, Fertilo, which is currently in late-stage development within the US.

items.title: IDWeek 2026: despite missing primary endpoint, LB6V shows promise in Lyme disease
items.summary: The commercial opportunity for a prophylactic Lyme disease vaccine in the US and Europe is substantial. LB6V is well placed to capitalise on this gap.

items.title: Astellas fortifies immuno-oncology pipeline on $1.3bn Audax licensing deal
items.summary: Astellas pens this immuno-oncology deal with Audax as it looks to offset the upcoming patent expiry of key portfolio medicine, Xtandi.

items.title: Anthropic plots IPO amid ongoing foray into drug development
items.summary: Anthropic hopes Powerful AI will “match or exceed the cognitive capabilities of top human experts across scientific disciplines”.

items.title: FDA grants orphan drug status to Octant’s OCT-980 for RP
items.summary: The FDA has granted orphan drug designation to Octant’s OCT-980, an investigational oral small molecule, to treat retinitis pigmentosa.
